newsitem.title: USA: Lott wants vote next month on U.S. balanced budget.
newsitem.headline: Lott wants vote next month on U.S. balanced budget.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Tuesday he wants a Senate vote next month on a constitutional amendment requiring a balanced federal budget.
The Mississippi Republican told reporters that Senate debate on the proposed amendment should begin next Wednesday or Thursday.

A difference developed between Lott and Senate Democratic Leader Thomas Daschle over negotiations on a congressional budget resolution for next year. Daschle said hard talks should start next week. Lott said talks should be informal.
